claims.evidence: Gemma 3n models are designed for efficient execution on low-resource devices. They are capable of multimodal input, handling text, image, video, and audio input, and generating text outputs

claims.value: Gemma 3n is a multimodal model from Google DeepMind with an effective size of 2B and 4B parameters using selective parameter activation technology, available in pre-trained and instruction-tuned variants for text, image, video, and audio inputs.
claims.evidence: While the raw parameter count of this model is 8B, the architecture design allows the model to be run with a memory footprint comparable to a traditional 4B model
They are available in two sizes based on effective parameters. While the raw parameter count of this model is 8B
Total output length up to 32K tokens, subtracting the request input tokens
They use a MatFormer architecture that allows nesting sub-models within the E4B model.

claims.value: Gemma 3n E4B is an instruction-tuned multimodal model supporting text, image, video, and audio inputs with text outputs.
Images are normalized to 256x256, 512x512, or 768x768 resolution and encoded to 256 tokens each; audio is encoded to 6.25 tokens per second from a single channel.
claims.evidence: Images, normalized to 256x256, 512x512, or 768x768 resolution and encoded to 256 tokens each
